page.overview:
Who is Dono?

is a Bormodo farmer and rancher in Razora on Ruidus; his cytaa is Kaniey. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.

Dono was described as hulking-looking and round-backed, with arms like tree trunks, an elephantine nose with thin nostrils, and thick brows.

Dono seemed to struggle with decision-making, and was upset and anxious because his symbiote cytaa Kaniey was too young to offer advice. However, even through his fear and anxiety on encountering Bells Hells unexpectedly, he was also curious. He described himself as "simple farm folk".

Dono had recently lost his symbiote cytaa, and was raising a new one named Kaniey, who was still very young and unable to speak as yet.
